::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/reports/usage_margin"}
#docs
A line with no full cost is counted in `lines_without_cost` and left out of revenue and cost. One row per group and currency; currencies are never added together.

`scope=all` also counts usage that no invoice line bills (cost only): its cost per day, from the event's own cost or your cost (else the list), as on a usage line. A day of usage is cost only when no usage line of an invoice that is not voided covers that day for the customer and meter, and no live subscription will bill it. By customer and by plan, `total_revenue_minor` holds every revenue line in the range (plan fees, usage, one-time sales), after discounts and credit notes, before tax. The cost-only figures are written each night for the days up to yesterday. The fields of `scope=billed` keep their meaning in both scopes. Needs `usage_margin:view`.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | The business's id (biz_…). |

## Query parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `from` | `string · ISO-8601` | **yes** | Start, inclusive (RFC 3339). |
| `to` | `string · ISO-8601` | **yes** | End, exclusive (RFC 3339). At most 366 days after `from`. |
| `group_by` | `string` | no | Default `customer`. `plan`: the plan of the invoice's subscription, and for cost-only usage the plan of the customer's subscription live that day; `""` = no plan. |
| `scope` | `string` | no | `billed` (default): usage lines only. `all`: also usage no invoice line bills, and every revenue line by customer and plan. |
| `currency` | `string` | no | One currency only. |
| `customer` | `string` | no | One customer's id (cus_…). |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `usage_margin`. One of `usage_margin`. |
| `group_by` | `string` | The usage margin's group by. One of `customer`, `model`, `meter`, `plan`. |
| `scope` | `string` | The usage margin's scope. One of `billed`, `all`. |
| `from` | `string · ISO-8601` | The usage margin's from. |
| `to` | `string · ISO-8601` | The usage margin's to. |
| `data` | `array of object` | The rows on this page. |
| `data.customer` | `string` | The customer's id (cus_…). |
| `data.customer_name` | `string` | With `group_by=customer`: the customer's name, else its email. |
| `data.model` | `string` | The pricing model. |
| `data.meter` | `string` | The usage margin's meter. |
| `data.meter_name` | `string` | With `group_by=meter`: the meter's name. |
| `data.plan` | `string` | The plan product's id; `""` = no plan. |
| `data.plan_name` | `string` | With `group_by=plan`: the plan product's name. |
| `data.currency` | `string` | The usage margin's currency (ISO-4217 code). |
| `data.revenue_minor` | `integer` | After discounts and credit notes, before tax. |
| `data.cost_minor` | `integer` | The cost in minor units (integer), e.g. 2900 = $29.00. |
| `data.margin_minor` | `integer` | The margin in minor units (integer), e.g. 2900 = $29.00. |
| `data.margin_percent` | `string` | The usage margin's margin percent. |
| `data.lines` | `integer` | The usage margin's lines. |
| `data.lines_without_cost` | `integer` | The usage margin's lines without cost. |
| `data.total_revenue_minor` | `integer` | With `scope=all`. By customer and plan: every revenue line. By meter and model: every usage line, also those with no full cost. |
| `data.cost_only_minor` | `integer` | With `scope=all`. Cost of usage that no invoice line bills. |
| `data.cost_only_rows` | `integer` | With `scope=all`. Days of cost-only usage, per customer, meter and group values. |
| `data.cost_only_rows_without_cost` | `integer` | With `scope=all`. Of `cost_only_rows`, those with no full cost: not in `cost_only_minor`. |
| `data.total_cost_minor` | `integer` | With `scope=all`. `cost_minor` + `cost_only_minor`. |
| `data.total_margin_minor` | `integer` | With `scope=all`. `total_revenue_minor` − `total_cost_minor`. |
| `data.total_margin_percent` | `string` | With `scope=all`. Null when `total_revenue_minor` is 0. |
| `data.plan_fee_minor` | `integer` | With `scope=all` and `group_by=plan`. Recurring and proration lines of plan products. |
| `data.subscribers` | `integer` | With `scope=all` and `group_by=plan`. Customers with a subscription on the plan that was live in the range. |
| `totals` | `array of object` | The usage margin's totals. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | The margin per group and the totals per currency. |
| `400` | The range is not correct. |
| `404` | No such customer. |

```bash [Request]
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY"
```
